evidence_kind: User-reported hardware failure correlated with actual source; no r9 native execution
reported_observations: Host game opened and waited in the menu for authority startup.
Payload rejected authority startup with authority_port_mismatch: transport target must use the configured game listen port.
Host game closed through failure cleanup; member game never launched.
source_cause: Legacy start binds an ephemeral loopback UDP adapter socket and exposes its bound address as the local client/proxy target.
The r8 HOST path used RoomController.prepare_launch().target for the authority IPC request, although that target is the bound proxy socket.
The r8 authority command omitted -port and -external, leaving Payload Config.Port/ExternalPort at 7777.
Payload checks the IPC endpoint port against Config.ExternalPort (or Config.Port) before native authority creation and correctly rejects the mismatch.
The r9 fix supplies a separate native authority endpoint, explicitly configures -port and -external from it, and retains native port validation.
privacy: No account identifiers, tokens, allocation, grants, pipe session names, native nonces, or raw server logs included.
actual_remote_proxy_port: NOT_CAPTURED_IN_USER_LOG; 49152 in regression tests is synthetic
